Kode ESP32 / Arduino (.ino)

Upload kode C++ berikut ke ESP32 menggunakan Arduino IDE. Sinyal dikirim via Serial USB ke website ini secara real-time.

esp32_soundboard.ino 
// ============================================================
// ESP32 Soundboard Firmware for Web Serial Studio
// Sambungkan 6 Tombol Push Button ke Pin GPIO 4, 5, 18, 19, 21, 22
// Tombol menyambungkan Pin ke GND (Internal Pullup Digunakan)
// ============================================================

#define NUM_BUTTONS 6

// Pin GPIO yang terhubung ke tombol
const int buttonPins[NUM_BUTTONS] = {4, 5, 18, 19, 21, 22};

// Karakter sinyal yang dikirim ke Website
const char buttonKeys[NUM_BUTTONS] = {'1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6'};

// Parameter Debounce
unsigned long lastDebounceTime[NUM_BUTTONS] = {0};
bool lastButtonState[NUM_BUTTONS] = {HIGH};
bool buttonState[NUM_BUTTONS] = {HIGH};
const unsigned long debounceDelay = 50; // 50ms debounce

void setup() {
  // Inisialisasi Serial ke 115200 Baud (Sesuaikan dengan Website)
  Serial.begin(115200);

  // Inisialisasi Pin Tombol dengan Input Pullup (Aktif LOW)
  for (int i = 0; i < NUM_BUTTONS; i++) {
    pinMode(buttonPins[i], INPUT_PULLUP);
  }

  Serial.println("[ESP32 SOUNDBOARD READY]");
}

void loop() {
  for (int i = 0; i < NUM_BUTTONS; i++) {
    int reading = digitalRead(buttonPins[i]);

    // Jika status pin berubah (karena ditekan atau noise)
    if (reading != lastButtonState[i]) {
      lastDebounceTime[i] = millis();
    }

    if ((millis() - lastDebounceTime[i]) > debounceDelay) {
      if (reading != buttonState[i]) {
        buttonState[i] = reading;

        // Tombol Ditekan (LOW karena INPUT_PULLUP)
        if (buttonState[i] == LOW) {
          // Kirim karakter sinyal tombol ke Website
          Serial.println(buttonKeys[i]);
        }
      }
    }
    lastButtonState[i] = reading;
  }
}

Skema Wiring Rangkaian ESP32:

  • Tombol 1 (Suara 1): Pin GPIO 4 ➔ Tombol Push ➔ GND
  • Tombol 2 (Suara 2): Pin GPIO 5 ➔ Tombol Push ➔ GND
  • Tombol 3 (Suara 3): Pin GPIO 18 ➔ Tombol Push ➔ GND
  • Tombol 4 (Suara 4): Pin GPIO 19 ➔ Tombol Push ➔ GND
  • Tombol 5 (Suara 5): Pin GPIO 21 ➔ Tombol Push ➔ GND
  • Tombol 6 (Suara 6): Pin GPIO 22 ➔ Tombol Push ➔ GND
